label: validate-corrected-system-data-content-and-metadata
command: import subprocess,json,pathlib; subprocess.run(["tools/local/usr/bin/fsck.erofs","--extract=downloads/verified-wayne-system","--no-preserve-owner","artifacts/experimental/system.img"],check=True); subprocess.run(["python3","tools/verify_system_contents.py","research/candidates/mi8937-os4/system","downloads/verified-wayne-system","research/candidates/mi8937-os4/inode-metadata.json","artifacts/experimental/overlay.tar","research/wayne-system-content-check.json"],check=True); import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"tools"); from erofs_metadata import inventory; new=inventory(pathlib.Path("artifacts/experimental/system.img"),"tools/local/usr/bin/dump.erofs"); pathlib.Path("research/wayne-os4-system-metadata.json").write_text(json.dumps(new,indent=2)+"\n"); old=json.load(open("research/candidates/mi8937-os4/inode-metadata.json")); differences=[p for p,r in old["paths"].items() if any(r[k]!=new["paths"].get(p,{}).get(k) for k in ["uid","gid","mode","xattrs_base64"])]; report={"original_paths":len(old["paths"]),"rebuilt_paths":len(new["paths"]),"differences":differences,"new_paths":sorted(set(new["paths"])-set(old["paths"])),"success":not differences}; pathlib.Path("research/wayne-system-metadata-check.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n"); print(json.dumps(report,indent=2)); assert report["success"]
